article.story: Wisconsin (6-3) at Maryland (3-6), Nov. 14 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Wisconsin by 7.5. Against the spread: Wisconsin 5-4, Maryland 4-5. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Wisconsin Offense Overall: 323.2 yards per game (121st in FBS) Passing: 186.7 yards per game (114th) Rushing: 136.6 yards per game (96th) Scoring: 24.4 points per game (95th) Wisconsin Defense Overall: 286.4 yards per game (14th in FBS) Passing: 185.3 yards per game (25th) Rushing: 101.1 yards per game (19th) Scoring: 16.3 points per game (15th) Maryland Offense Overall: 369.1 yards per game (79th in FBS) Passing: 239.6 yards per game (53rd) Rushing: 129.6 yards per game (107th) Scoring: 27.7 points per game (72nd) Maryland Defense Overall: 377.6 yards per game (89th in FBS) Passing: 227.1 yards per game (90th) Rushing: 150.4 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 31.3 points per game (118th) Maryland ranks 102nd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 41.3% of the time. Wisconsin ranks 51st on offense, converting on 41.6% of third downs. Maryland is 125th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 93.3% of trips. Wisconsin's red zone offense ranks 21st, scoring on 92.3% of red zone opportunities. Both teams rank low in time of possession. Wisconsin is 128th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:27, while Maryland's 131st-ranked average is 27:05. Team leaders Wisconsin Passing: Colton Joseph, 1,346 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 55.6 completion percentage Rushing: Joseph, 371 yards on 91 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tyrell Henry, 410 yards on 33 catches, 1 TD Maryland Passing: Malik Washington, 2,058 yards, 11 TDs, 8 INTs, 60.9 completion percentage Rushing: DeJuan Williams, 437 yards on 71 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Chris Durr Jr., 765 yards on 62 catches, 5 TDs Last game Wisconsin beat Rutgers 31-10 on Nov. 7. Ryan Hopkins led Wisconsin with 241 yards on 18-of-24 passing (75.0%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. Eugene Hilton Jr. carried the ball three times for 39 yards, adding four receptions for 44 yards and one touchdown. Shamar Rigby put up 71 yards on four catches. Maryland won 34-29 over Purdue on Nov. 7. Washington led Maryland with 253 yards on 13-of-18 passing (72.2%) for two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball eight times for 32 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Williams carried the ball 14 times for 99 yards and scored one touchdown. Durr had four receptions for 127 yards and one touchdown. Next game Wisconsin plays at Purdue on Nov. 21. Maryland plays at No. 15 USC on Nov. 21.
